title: Custom agent frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of .github/agents/*.agent.md. Runtime fields describe how the agent behaves; governance fields make the agent body a versioned, owned, auditable prompt artifact on par with prompts/**.yaml.

name.description: Agent identifier. MUST match the filename stem (e.g. 'assessor' for assessor.agent.md).

description.description: What this agent does, in prose. Surfaced in the agent picker.

tools.description: MCP tools and file/terminal capabilities this agent may call.

preferred_models.description: Ordered model preference. First reachable model wins.

bundle_subscriptions.description: Standards bundles injected by the SessionStart hook. Bundles are law and override instruction layers.

ledger_writes.description: Declared ledger entry types this agent is permitted to write. An agent that writes an undeclared entry type is a governance violation.

prompt_id.description: Stable identifier across versions of this logical agent. Does not change when version increments.

version.description: Immutable once status is 'published'. A change to a published agent ships as a new version file, and the old one is marked superseded.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'published' agents are considered active.

owner_persona.description: Who is accountable for this agent's instructions and who reviews changes to it.

git_sha.description: Commit SHA at which this version was published. Set by CI on merge.

authored_by.description: UPN or handle of the author of this version.

reason.description: Why this version exists. Read directly in audit; write it for a reader who was not in the room.

superseded_by.description: Set when this version is retired, naming the version that replaced it.

prompt_ref.description: prompt_id of the YAML prompt this agent inherits its shared instruction block from. MUST resolve to a published prompt in the catalog. Explicitly null for agents with no pipeline counterpart (pipeline-doctor, standards-change, review-loop-controller) — those are governed by this frontmatter alone.
